summary.headline: Planetary Exaltations and Oppositions
summary.text: Discussion of planetary exaltations and humblings: Zeus and Ares govern life and death, Hermes and Aphrodite rationality and desire, and the Moon fortune. Section 8 explains the oppositions between the planetary houses of the Sun and Moon, Cronus, Hermes, Zeus, Ares, and Aphrodite through their stellar natures.
